name: Guman Pratap Singh
tagline: Builder of small, stubbornly useful things
kicker: Software Engineer at Finzly · Weekend Tinkerer
bio: I'm an Associate Software Engineer at Finzly, working on payment processing and cloud infrastructure for multi-tenant banking platforms that serve 50+ financial institutions. Day to day that is Java, Spring Boot and AWS, and a fair amount of talking to product managers and banking clients about what they actually need.
Outside that I build small things that do one job well — voice agents that answer the phone, WhatsApp bots that take orders, tools that run on free tiers. Most of it started on a Saturday.

points: Leading development of payment processing features and cloud infrastructure for multi-tenant banking clients serving 50+ financial institutions.
Work directly with product managers and banking clients to gather requirements, clarify business workflows, and translate them into scalable technical solutions.
Cut Payment Blotter API response time from 2–3 seconds to 300–600 ms through query optimization.
Built a scheduled Holiday Job that ingests third-party holiday data, stores files in environment-specific S3 buckets, and updates multi-tenant databases.
Built an HTML editor for client notification templates with automatic synchronization to S3 and GitHub.
Replaced Javers with audit logging via SQL triggers and AWS Lambda, reducing container overhead and enabling frontend audit visibility.
Integrated the Twilio Lookup API in Java to validate global phone numbers, and extended Angular UI components for in-app navigation.
Worked on unsupervised synthetic-to-real domain adaptation for image segmentation.
Investigated existing segmentation solutions and datasets including SYNTHIA, Cityscapes, ADE20K and COCO.
Explored visualization techniques to make domain adaptation results more interpretable.

education.school: SRM Institute of Science and Technology — Chennai, TN
